name: Angelic Aspect (Legendary Games)
body:
School transmutation [good]; Level paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF/F (feather from a good-aligned outsider)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one willing creature
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You transformed the touched creature into the semblance of a winged angelic being. The target’s skin, eyes, hair, and feathers take on a gleaming, metallic appearance, and it gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma and a +1 sacred bonus to AC and on saving throws against attacks or effects used by evil creatures. The target’s wings grant it a fly speed of 30 feet (average maneuverability). While using angelic aspect, the target’s head is surrounded by a glowing halo equivalent to a light spell. This halo results in a -20 penalty on Stealth checks and clearly reveals the creature’s position even if it is invisible.
